  (function () {
    var KEY = 'pstonn-theme', saved = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    if (saved) document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', saved);
    function toggle() {
      var cur = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
      var sysDark = matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme:dark)').matches;
      var isDark = cur ? cur === 'dark' : sysDark;
      var next = isDark ? 'light' : 'dark';
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
      localStorage.setItem(KEY, next);
    }
    
    
    
    
    
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-theme-toggle]')) toggle();
    });
    
    
    
    
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-share-pstonn]');
      if (!btn) return;
      
      
      var url = location.origin;
      var msg = 'Schedule your Stonnington visitor parking permit';
      if (navigator.share) {
        navigator.share({ title: 'p.stonn', text: msg, url: url }).catch(function () {});
      } else if (navigator.clipboard) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(function () {
          btn.textContent = 'Link copied';
        }).catch(function () {});
      }
    });
  })();

<script nonce="NONCE">
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  (function () {
    var native = document.startViewTransition;
    if (!native) return;
    var noop = function () {};
    document.startViewTransition = function () {
      var t = native.apply(document, arguments);
      if (t) {
        if (t.ready && t.ready.catch) t.ready.catch(noop);
        if (t.finished && t.finished.catch) t.finished.catch(noop);
      }
      return t;
    };
  })();

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  window.pstonnWake = (function () {
    var lock = null, want = false;
    function acquire() {
      if (!want || lock || !('wakeLock' in navigator) || document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return;
      navigator.wakeLock.request('screen').then(function (l) {
        if (!want) { try { l.release(); } catch (e) {} return; }
        lock = l;
        l.addEventListener('release', function () { lock = null; });
      }).catch(function () {}); 
    }
    function release() {
      want = false;
      if (lock) { try { lock.release(); } catch (e) {} lock = null; }
    }
    
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') acquire();
    });
    return {
      on: function () { want = true; acquire(); },
      off: release,
      
      
      
      
      sync: function () {
        var live = Array.prototype.some.call(
          document.querySelectorAll('[data-keep-awake]'),
          function (el) { return el.getClientRects().length > 0; });
        if (live) { this.on(); } else { release(); }
      }
    };
  })();
  document.addEventListener('htmx:afterSettle', function () { window.pstonnWake.sync(); });
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { window.pstonnWake.sync(); });
</script>

  addEventListener('htmx:beforeRequest', function (e) { var el = e.detail && e.detail.elt; if (el && el.classList && el.classList.contains('hx-quiet')) return; var b = document.getElementById('htmx-bar'); if (b) b.classList.add('on'); });
  addEventListener('htmx:afterRequest', function () { var b = document.getElementById('htmx-bar'); if (b) b.classList.remove('on'); });
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  addEventListener('htmx:sendError', function (e) {
    var cfg = e.detail && e.detail.requestConfig;
    if (!cfg || !cfg.boosted) return;
    if (cfg.verb === 'get' && cfg.path) { window.location.href = cfg.path; }
    else { window.location.reload(); }
  });
  
  
  
  
  
  
  addEventListener('htmx:beforeSwap', function (e) {
    var x = e.detail && e.detail.xhr;
    if (!x || x.status < 400) return;
    e.detail.shouldSwap = false;
    if (x.status === 422) {
      e.detail.isError = false;
      showToast((x.responseText || 'Something needs your attention.').trim());
      return;
    }
    var msg = 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
    var body = x.responseText || '';
    if (body.lastIndexOf('<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><body', 0) === 0) {
      try {
        var p = new DOMParser().parseFromString(body, 'text/html').querySelector('p');
        if (p && p.textContent.trim()) msg = p.textContent.trim();
      } catch (err) {}
    }
    
    
    
    
    showToast(msg, true);
  });
  var toastTimer;
  
  function showToast(msg, sticky) {
    var t = document.getElementById('toast');
    if (!t) return;
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    t.textContent = msg;
    t.classList.toggle('sticky', !!sticky);
    if (sticky) {
      var x = document.createElement('button');
      x.type = 'button';
      x.className = 'toast-x';
      x.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Dismiss');
      x.textContent = '×';
      x.addEventListener('click', function () { t.classList.remove('on'); });
      t.appendChild(x);
    } else {
      toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { t.classList.remove('on'); }, 5000);
    }
    t.classList.add('on');
  }
</script>
<script nonce="NONCE">

window.popClamp = window.popClamp || function (el) {
  el.style.removeProperty('--pop-shift');
  var pad = 12, vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  var r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), dx = 0;
  if (r.left < pad) dx = pad - r.left;
  else if (r.right > vw - pad) dx = vw - pad - r.right;
  if (dx) el.style.setProperty('--pop-shift', dx + 'px');
  el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
};
(function () {
  if (window.appConfirm) return; 
  var pending = null;
  function dlg() { return document.getElementById('confirm-dlg'); }
  function settle(ok) {
    var d = dlg(), res = pending;
    pending = null;
    if (d && d.open) d.close();
    if (res) res(ok);
  }
  window.appConfirm = function (message, okLabel) {
    var d = dlg();
    if (!d || typeof d.showModal !== 'function') return Promise.resolve(window.confirm(message));
    if (pending) pending(false);
    d.querySelector('.dlg-msg').textContent = message;
    d.querySelector('.dlg-ok').textContent = okLabel || 'Confirm';
    d.showModal();
    return new Promise(function (res) { pending = res; });
  };
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var d = dlg();
    if (!d || !d.open) return;
    if (e.target.closest('.dlg-ok')) settle(true);
    else if (e.target.closest('.dlg-cancel') || e.target === d) settle(false); 
  });
  document.addEventListener('cancel', function (e) { 
    if (e.target === dlg() && pending) { var res = pending; pending = null; res(false); }
  }, true);
  
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var el = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-print],[data-dispatch]') : null;
    if (!el) return;
    if (el.hasAttribute('data-print')) window.print();
    var name = el.getAttribute('data-dispatch');
    
    if (name) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name, {detail:{permit: el.getAttribute('data-dispatch-permit') || ''}}));
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    var f = e.target, field = f.dataset && f.dataset.plateConfirm;
    if (!field || f.__confirmed) return;
    var inp = f.querySelector('[name="' + field + '"]');
    var v = inp ? (inp.value || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[\s\-.·]+/g, '') : '';
    if (!inp || inp.offsetParent === null || !v) { delete f.dataset.confirm; return; }
    f.dataset.confirm = 'You typed ' + v + ' — check it against the car’s actual number plate. ' +
      'Letter O vs zero 0 and letter I vs one 1 are easy to mix up, and a wrong plate means the car is not covered.';
    f.dataset.confirmOk = 'It matches — continue';
  }, true);
  
  document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    var f = e.target, msg = f.dataset && f.dataset.confirm;
    if (!msg) return;
    if (f.__confirmed) { f.__confirmed = false; return; }
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    appConfirm(msg, f.dataset.confirmOk).then(function (ok) {
      if (!ok) return;
      f.__confirmed = true;
      if (f.requestSubmit) f.requestSubmit(); else f.submit();
    });
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('htmx:confirm', function (e) {
    if (!e.detail.question) return; 
    e.preventDefault();
    var elt = e.detail.elt;
    appConfirm(e.detail.question, elt && elt.dataset ? elt.dataset.confirmOk : null)
      .then(function (ok) { if (ok) e.detail.issueRequest(true); });
  });
})();
</script>

<main id="main" tabindex="-1" class="landing about">
  <section class="paper">
    <h1 class="about-h1">Do visitors need a paper permit in Stonnington?</h1>
    <p>Not usually. Permits are digital by default: there&#39;s nothing to display, and parking officers check the plate against your permit. Physical permits you already hold stay valid until they expire, and the council will issue one on application in exceptional circumstances — disability, carer arrangements, or limited online access.</p>
    <h2 class="about-h2">To see which plate is on your permit now</h2>
    <ol class="guide-steps">
      <li>Sign in at <a href="https://parkingpermits.stonnington.vic.gov.au/ssp/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">parkingpermits.stonnington.vic.gov.au</a> — <a href="https://parkingpermits.stonnington.vic.gov.au/idm/account/Register" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">register</a> first if you haven’t, or <a href="https://parkingpermits.stonnington.vic.gov.au/idm/account/ForgotPassword" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">reset your password</a> if you’ve never used it.</li><li>Find the visitor permit in your Current Permit list &mdash; the vehicle shown is the one that&rsquo;s covered right now.</li><li>If it&rsquo;s the wrong car, choose <strong>Update Vehicle</strong> and enter the visitor&rsquo;s registration before they park.</li>
    </ol>
    <p>Physical permits: see <a href="https://www.stonnington.vic.gov.au/Services/Parking/Parking-permits/Visitor-parking-permits" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">the council’s visitor-permit page</a> for the exceptional-circumstances application, or ring 03 8290 1333.</p>
    <h2 class="about-h2">With p.stonn</h2>
    <div class="feature" style="margin-top:8px">
      <div class="feature-text"><p>A weekly roster for regulars, one-off bookings for everyone else, a link or QR your visitors use themselves — and a notification each time the plate changes, so you know who&#39;s covered.</p></div>
      <div class="feature-demo">

          <div class="dm-fld"><div class="k">From</div><div class="val"><span class="dm-fade">Sat 12 Jul, 9:00am</span></div></div>

    <p class="faq-more">p.stonn is a free, unofficial tool and is not affiliated with the City of Stonnington. The council’s own pages: <a href="https://www.stonnington.vic.gov.au/Services/Parking/Parking-permits/Visitor-parking-permits" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">visitor parking permits</a> and <a href="https://www.stonnington.vic.gov.au/Services/Parking/Parking-permits/About-digital-parking-permits/Parking-permit-FAQs" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">parking permit FAQs</a>.
